source.repro: npx esbuild plugins/maf/benches/mafEncodeRows.bench.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/mafEncodeRows.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=12000 /tmp/mafEncodeRows.mjs --rounds=15 --json
source.notes: On ada (load under 1). Main-thread cost per fetch of the MAF display's placeMafRegionData and encodeMafRows (bases on, identity off, conservation off, no codons), over a contiguous stretch of the synthetic MAF-tabix fixture (250-column blocks every 240 bp), opened as a sub-window of the stated fetched span. A 15 kb fetch is a 7.5 kb view, binBp 1 below 4 bp/px (a view about 2000 px wide) and binBp 2 at 1200 px; a 40 kb fetch is a 20 kb view at binBp 8, the widest span where bases draw. Every encode arm runs over a region placed fresh and untimed just before it, because mafInsertionChannels caches its walk per region and a fetch always lands a new one; a WeakSet of the timed regions fails the run if one repeats. Channels is buildMafChannels and insertions walk is mafInsertionChannels, each over its own cold region; encode is encodeMafRows whole, control the same declared again, and place + encode both in one call, which is the per-fetch cost. Interleaved round-robin with the order rotated, MIN across 15 rounds after 2 warmups. Cells and insertions are what the two walks emitted.
